name: Rumpke Waste & Recycling
notes: Researched from public rumpke.com pages (Pay My Bill, Contact Us) and the public RumpkePay sign-in page (Kubra i-doxs; observed, never signed in). RumpkePay accepts credit cards, debit cards and bank accounts; a $2.95 convenience fee applies to every one-time online payment (card or bank) and to all phone payments, and enrolling in auto-pay avoids it (modelled as a flat $2.95 bank and card fee on one-time payments). Phone payments (800-828-8171, 24/7) take Visa, Mastercard and Discover only. Walmart MoneyCenter/customer service desks and Rumpke facilities take in-person payments (fee applies). Sign-in is Username + Password with a personal sign-in seal; Make a OneTime Payment needs no account. Paperless, autopay timing, late fees and payment plans are not published (family defaults kept). No online stop-service form exists: the Contact Us page lists forms to request, transfer or update service and says to call 800-828-8171 otherwise, so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred). Integrated 2026-10-09: labels.autopay set to "Auto-Pay" now that the template uses the label as a noun ("Turn off Auto-Pay").

pay_by_phone.note: 24/7 automated line; Visa, Mastercard and Discover only; $2.95 fee.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Rumpke customer service at 800-828-8171 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm ET) to stop service.

help.title: Ways to pay your Rumpke bill
paragraphs: RumpkePay, Rumpke's online system powered by Kubra, takes credit cards, debit cards and bank accounts. Register to manage your account, or use Make a OneTime Payment without signing up. Each one-time online payment carries a $2.95 convenience fee; enroll in auto-pay to avoid it.
Pay by phone any time at 800-828-8171 and choose the pay by phone option. Phone payments accept Visa, Mastercard and Discover and always carry the $2.95 fee.

You can also pay in person at a Rumpke facility or at any Walmart MoneyCenter or customer service desk (bring your current statement and cash or a PIN debit card; a fee applies), or mail a check. Residential payments go to Rumpke, P.O. Box 538709, Cincinnati, OH 45253-8709.
steps: Open Pay My Bill and go to RumpkePay.
Sign In, or choose Make a OneTime Payment.
Enter the amount and a card or bank account.

help.title: Auto-pay with RumpkePay
paragraphs: Register for RumpkePay to set up auto-pay from a card or bank account. Auto-pay payments do not carry the $2.95 convenience fee charged on one-time online and phone payments.

help.title: Starting, moving or stopping service
paragraphs: Use the Request Service form to start or add service, Transfer Service when you move to a new address, and Update My Information to change account details.
There is no online form to stop service. Call customer service at 800-828-8171, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern.

help.title: Signing in to RumpkePay
paragraphs: RumpkePay signs you in with a username and password. Choose Sign up now under Don't have an account? to register. Forgot your Username/Password? helps you recover either one.
You can set a personal sign-in seal (a message or picture). Check that your seal appears each time you sign in; if it does not, you may not be on the real site.
